user.title: Battery Plan
user.description: Plans battery charging and export against your Octopus tariff. Give this planner a name.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Pick your battery and Octopus Energy integration entities. Everything can be changed later under Configure.

data_description.capacity_kwh: Usable battery energy between 0 and 100% SOC.
data_description.target_soc: SOC the overnight charge aims for.
data_description.reserve_soc: Planned exports stop at this SOC so the house can run until the next charge.
data_description.min_soc: Battery stops discharging below this (e.g. Victron ESS minimum SoC); the house then runs from grid.

data_description.import_rates: Octopus Energy integration events, e.g. …_current_day_rates and …_next_day_rates (import meter).
data_description.export_rates: The same events for the export meter (Agile Outgoing). Leave empty if you don't export.
data_description.standing_charge_entity: Optional: daily standing charge (…_current_standing_charge), subtracted from daily net.

data_description.charge_start: Start of the cheap-rate grid-charge window.
data_description.charge_mode: Full power, or spread over the window to finish shortly before it ends.
data_description.max_charge_kw: Battery-side charge power at full rate.
data_description.min_charge_kw: Spread mode never charges slower than this.
data_description.makeup_kw: Spread mode adds this on top of the calculated rate.
data_description.finish_early_min: Spread mode aims to finish this long before the window ends.
data_description.finish_early_full_min: Used instead when the target is 100%, to allow time to balance.
data_description.long_balance_day: Optional: the night (window start day) that finishes even earlier.
data_description.charge_eff: Grid AC to battery, used for import energy and cost estimates.

data_description.saving_export_kw: Optional: power during Octopus saving sessions (defaults to the maximum above).
data_description.min_export_price: Only export in slots paying at least this.

data_description.load_entities: Optional: power sensors summed to learn an hourly load profile (e.g. AC loads L1–L3).
data_description.load_days: Days of statistics used for the load profile.
data_description.load_kw: Used when no load sensors are set, or for hours with no data.

data_description.dispatching_entity: Optional: …_intelligent_dispatching binary sensor; its planned dispatches are added to the plan.
data_description.dispatch_charges_battery: Treat dispatches outside the charge window as full-rate battery top-ups.
data_description.target_time_entity: Optional: …_intelligent_target_time select/time entity, for the dispatch-hours sensors.
data_description.free_calendar: Optional: Octoplus free electricity / power-up calendar.

data_description.grid_power_entity: Optional: grid power (import positive). Enables today's/yesterday's actual cost sensors.
data_description.grid_power_invert: Turn on if your sensor reports export as positive.

error.reserve_above_target: The export floor must be below the charge target.
error.min_above_reserve: Minimum SOC must not be above the export floor.
error.min_charge_above_max: Minimum charge power must not exceed the maximum.
